newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KOGER & SUMBERG WIN 15 MLN EEK TENDER.
newsitem.headline: KOGER & SUMBERG WIN 15 MLN EEK TENDER.

text.p: Koger and Sumberg, one of the largest construction companies in Estonia, said on Thursday that it had won a 15 million kroon tender for the third stage of the Parnu water purification plant's renovation.

Koger and Sumberg previously won the contact for the construction of the first stage of the renovation project located in Reiu in south-western Estonia, Koger and Sumberg's managing director Kaido Fridolin said in a statement.

The total cost of the project is 25 million kroons and it is being financed through the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and within the local government's environmental project framework.
